text: In 1996, [isolated teenagers Owen and Maddy|who_suffers|the lonely and isolated] bond over [The Pink Opaque, a late-night show about two psychic girls|images|pictures, screens and recordings] who fight the reality-warping Mr. Melancholy. Two years later Maddy runs away and vanishes. When she returns, she tells Owen that [their real lives are the show|rules|reality comes apart], that they are trapped in the Midnight Realm, and that [the way home is to be buried alive|images|graves, coffins and funerals].
